findings.body: The hook says the approval was recorded before the remaining checks and commit run. With a mismatched pin and missing client sign-off, it prints that claim and then refuses the approval. If the repo pins a newer Forge than is installed, it also tells the user to change the repo to the older installed version. Report a recorded approval only after it succeeds, and give version advice that matches the mismatch.
findings.title: Make the approval warning match the outcome and version direction

findings.body: The right-folder message interpolates the worktree path directly into `cd {folder}`. A common path such as `/Users/Someone/My Repo` makes the suggested command fail when copied. Quote the path for the shell or state the folder change without presenting a broken command.
findings.title: Make the suggested folder change usable when the path contains spaces

findings.body: On every pin mismatch, this comprehension reads `forge.toml` from every worktree before deciding whether a pending upgrade qualifies. If an unrelated worktree's file has invalid UTF-8 or cannot be read, the exception escapes instead of allowing the healthy upgrade or giving the usual pin refusal. The current checkout's `repo.config` handles invalid encoding at `src/forge/repo.py:153-161`; candidate worktrees need equivalent handling.
findings.title: Keep an unrelated unreadable worktree from breaking the version gate
